title: Seat walk-through
intro: Walk the rows before doors open with a laptop on a cable. Plug it into each seat's socket and press Locate: Floorbit finds the switch port from the laptop's address and keeps it for the seat.
skipKnown_one: Skip the {{count}} seat that already has a port
skipKnown_other: Skip the {{count}} seats that already have a port
allKnown: Every seat of this block has a port
kept: Ports found are kept for {{event}} only and cleared {{hours}} hours after it ends.
portfast: The access ports need portfast (or edge port): without it a port takes about 30 seconds to come up after the cable goes in.
notSeatNetwork: This laptop has {{ip}}, which is not in the seat networks. Turn off Wi-Fi and plug the laptop into a seat.
noLookup: Nothing can look up switch ports yet. Turn on SSH port actions with a stored switch login, telemetry or LibreNMS, or connect a local agent.
plugIn: Plug the laptop into the socket at {{seat}}, wait for the link light, then press Locate (or Enter).
hadWalk: Found before on this walk-through: {{port}}. Locating again replaces it.
hadCheckin: Known from a check-in: {{port}}. Locating again replaces it.
looking: Looking up this laptop's port… {{seconds}} s
lookingMonitoring: Waiting for the monitoring source to see the laptop on its new port. It only knows after it polls the switch, which can take a minute.
stillOld: The switch still shows the laptop on the last seat's port. It updates once the new link is up.
replaced: This port was saved for {{seats}} before; that is gone now.
planSays: The patch plan puts {{other}} on {{port}}, and the plan wins on the floor plan.
fixPlan: Put {{seat}} there in the patch plan
failedStale: The switch kept showing the laptop on the last seat's port. Unplug, plug in again and check the link light.
failedPort: The laptop's MAC is known, but no switch shows it on a seat port yet.
failedMac: Nobody knows the MAC for {{ip}} yet: the core's ARP table hasn't seen this laptop.
failedHint: Is the link light on? Without portfast the port takes about 30 seconds. Then try again, or skip the seat and come back later.
